class.name: ScriptDiagnosticCapture
class.brief_description: Low-level recorder for engine diagnostics during tests.
class.description: [ScriptDiagnosticCapture] registers a thread-local error handler and collects diagnostic events while active. Multiple active captures each receive every event (broadcast semantics). Use [ScriptDiagnosticCaptureScope] when a test runner needs scoped start/stop pairing across async code and failure paths. [b]Event schema[/b] Each event dictionary returned by [method get_event] and [method get_events] uses these stable keys: [code]severity[/code] ([int]), [code]severity_name[/code] ([String]), [code]message[/code], [code]code[/code], [code]rationale[/code], [code]function[/code], [code]file[/code], [code]line[/code] ([int]), and [code]editor_notify[/code] ([bool]). [b]Quiet mode[/b] When [method start] is called with [code]quiet = true[/code], captured events are still recorded but console printing is suppressed via a nest-safe global refcount. Quiet mode affects console output only; editor toasts, debugger presentation, and other channels are out of scope. [b]Composition with [ScriptTestExecution][/b] For project test runners, place diagnostic capture outside execution guards so guard-initiated unwinds (timeout/abort) never leak an active capture and the guard's silent unwind is not recorded as a spurious diagnostic: [codeblock] var diagnostics := ScriptDiagnosticCaptureScope.start(true) var execution_result: ScriptTestExecutionResult = await execution.guard_callv(suite, test_case.method_name, test_case.arguments) diagnostics.stop() context.set_diagnostics(diagnostics.capture) [/codeblock]

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all recorded events without stopping capture.

method.name: get_event
method.description: Returns the event dictionary at [param index].

method.name: get_event_count
method.description: Returns how many events have been recorded.

method.name: has_diagnostic
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when an event with [param severity] exists. When [param message] is non-empty, the event message must match exactly.

method.name: has_diagnostic_containing
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when an event with [param severity] exists whose message contains [param text]. When [param text] is empty, any event with the severity matches.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while this capture is registered.

method.name: is_quiet
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when this capture was started in quiet mode.

method.name: is_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code]. Addons can probe this stable contract point instead of checking [method ClassDB.class_exists] for [ScriptDiagnosticCapture].

method.name: start
method.description: Begins recording diagnostics. Safe to call only once until [method stop] is called.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops recording diagnostics and unregisters the error handler.
